title: R2 cross-facility ABA transfer screening protocol

engineering_gates.gate_origin: project engineering assumption aligned to the existing R2 ~5 mV transfer/repeatability scale; not a standards-derived equivalence margin
engineering_gates.interpretation: screening gate only; not a publication-grade statistical equivalence test

statuses.PASS: complete ABA packet with >=3 qualified primary devices and both aggregate gates satisfied
statuses.FAIL: complete packet but one or more aggregate gates fail, time ordering is invalid, device identity conflicts, or frozen configuration is violated
statuses.INCOMPLETE: required A1/B/A2 record, provenance, timing, configuration, or primary-device count is missing

claim_boundaries: PASS does not establish a quantum mechanism, EPC mechanism, commercial PV performance, or universal facility equivalence.
Repeated A1/B/A2 sessions on one device are correlated observations and do not create independent device count.
Linear home-facility drift can be removed by interpolation; nonlinear or shipping-induced state changes remain live conventional explanations.
A failed transfer remains a negative result and must not be tuned away by changing the gate after seeing B data.
